# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `quackle` MCP server pointing at quackle's hosted HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.quackle.io/`).
- Logo: references the submitted URL `https://quackle.io/assets/brand/quackle.png`; no local copy because quackle.io was unreachable.
